You call your companion’s name above the din, steadying their breath before panic or shock can take hold.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
One willing ally within 4 squares that can hear you, when it gains temporary Frightened or Dazed.
Duration
Immediate reduction of the new contribution.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; normal action economy applies.
Type
Signature

Reduce the newly applied contribution of that condition by up to 2, minimum 0, before it takes effect. This does not remove an older contribution or a starred source. No HP is restored.

Additional rulings

Tags: Skill / Recovery
